details.description: Discover the ancient wisdom of Ayurveda with Vahdam's Vedic Kadha Organic Herbal Tea. This time-honoured blend of traditional Indian herbs and spices is designed to rejuvenate your body and invigorate your senses. Crafted with meticulous attention to quality and authenticity, this potent herbal concoction promotes overall wellness and vitality. Tulsi, revered in Ayurveda for its adaptogenic properties, helps the body adapt to stress and maintain mental clarity. Ginger and black pepper lend their digestive and anti-inflammatory benefits, while the warmth of clove and cinnamon adds a delightful flavour. Brimming with the goodness of fresh root ginger, vitamin C-rich amla, and curcumin-rich turmeric, this natural herbal tea is a true delight for the senses. Enjoy it as a natural prevention for colds and coughs during the winter months, and experience the restorative power of this ancient Ayurvedic recipe.
